summary: NPC card hierarchy, interaction grouping, action emphasis, accessibility labeling, and responsive styling were implemented within the approved presentation scope. Existing form routes, methods, identifiers, names, and submitted values remain unchanged. Focused NPC coverage was added, guardrails report no violations, and the complete suite passes with 312 tests.
risks: Primary emphasis is derived from truthy duration_days; actions with a zero or absent duration remain secondary, which may warrant future visual review but does not alter behavior.
The agent report predates the successful orchestrator test run and therefore still describes test execution as blocked, although the supplied authoritative results confirm the full suite passed.
